Coram: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE RAHUL BHARTI, JUDGE  ORDER 22.05.2023 Writ petition-OWP no. 844/2010 filed by the present petitioners came to be disposed of by this Court in terms of an order dated 02.11.2022.

Disposal of the writ petition had taken place on being solicited by the petitioners themselves that as the Union of India had made deposit of the entire awarded amount with the Collector Land Acquisition, as such the disposal of the writ petition could take place with a direction to the respondents in the writ petition, who were the Collector Land Acquisition and the Deputy Commissioner, Reasi to release the awarded amount in favour of the petitioners.

A perusal of the order dated 02.11.2022 reflects that the petitioners had, at no point of time, ever shared with this Court the fact as to how much is the compensation payable to them in terms of the award so referred by them in terms whereof the Union of India had come forward to deposit.

In terms of the order dated 02.11.2022, the writ respondents were directed to release the award amount along with interest from the date of taking of the possession of the land in question till its actual realization after proper identification and verification provided the same had not already Bashir Ahmed And Anr vs Babila Rakwal on 22 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/88498025/
1 been released.

sentences.text: The needful compliance was to be carried out within a period of two months from the date a copy of the order to be made available to the respondents' no. 2 and 3 against proper receipt.

The petitioners through their representation dated 14.11.2022 submitted to the Collector Land Acquisition, Reasi staked their claim for release of an amount of Rs. 22,00,186/- along with interest @ 9% per annum from the year 2002 for the acquired land measuring 7.6 kanals falling under survey no. 228 min situated at Katra town district Reasi.

It seems that in terms of an exercise under the Land Acquisition Act, Svt. 1990, some 90.17 kanals of land had come to be acquired for the construction of approach road of Railway Station, Katra and in this very acquisition the petitioners'
land measuring 7.6 kanals under survey no. 228 min had also come to be involved.
This Court, in terms of its order dated 02.11.2022, in a very expressed terms mandated the respondents no. 2 and 3 to make the release of the award amount in favour of the petitioners.
The disposal of the writ petition had taken place in presence of the counsel for the respondents no. 2 and 3.

In addition, the petitioners on their part had also apprised the respondents about the direction of the Court but still the respondents herein opted not to act in compliance to the direction of the Court thereby constraining the petitioners to again have a recourse to litigation in the form of the present contempt petition.
Prima facie case is made out.
Mrs. Monika Kohli, learned Sr. AAG accepts notice on behalf of the respondents no. 1 and 2.
The respondents no. 1 and 2 shall file their respective statement of facts duly supported by their personal affidavit within a period of two weeks List again on 16.06.2023.
